name: Waveshare Modbus RTU Analog Input 8CH (4-20 mA / voltage to RS485)
doc_revision: Waveshare Wiki page 'Modbus RTU Analog Input 8CH' as fetched 2026-11; no document number or revision date
notes: Read via the Waveshare wiki page text (no PDF). Register table addresses are hex protocol addresses starting at 0x0000: channel data = '3x0000..3x0007' (input registers, FC04), range mode = '4x1000..4x1007' (FC03/06/10), UART = 0x2000 (FC03/06), device address = 0x4000 (FC03/06), software version = 0x8000 (FC03). address_base=0, addresses here are the hex values converted to decimal (0x1000=4096, 0x2000=8192, 0x4000=16384, 0x8000=32768); the wiki does not say whether 1-based tools should add one. Channel values are unsigned 16 bit and their unit depends on each channel's range mode: version (A): mode 0 = 0-5 V in mV, 1 = 1-5 V in mV, 2 = 0-20 mA in uA, 3 = 4-20 mA in uA, 4 = raw code 0..4096; default mode 2 (0-20 mA), jumpers connected. Because the unit depends on the mode, the preset exposes the raw value (unit left blank) plus a second 'CHn Current' set scaled to mA for use with 4-20 mA transmitters (valid only in modes 2/3). For raw mode 4 the wiki gives a conversion formula (voltage = code x 3300 / 4095 / op-amp ratio, current = voltage / sampling resistor; A: op-amp ratio 32.4/49.9, 249 ohm) that is not modelled. The wiki does not state factory defaults for baud rate, parity or address; its examples use 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, address 01, so the connection block is an example, not a documented default. Not modelled: nothing else is documented in the register table (no write-only commands).

points.name: UART Parameters
points.note: High byte = parity (0x00 none, 0x01/0x02 even/odd), low byte = baud code 0-7. The wiki lists 0x01/0x02 as even/odd in one place and odd/even in another, so parity is ambiguous; register is documented as R/W (FC03/06) but left read-only here for that reason. Enum only covers the no-parity values.

points.name: Device Address
points.note: Modbus slave address, 0x0001-0x00FF. Writing it moves the device to a new address.

points.name: Software Version
points.note: Raw decimal / 100 (0x0064 = V1.00).
